# SolisPLC

> > Expert-led online PLC programming and industrial automation training platform with hands-on courses, tutorials, and certification preparation.

SolisPLC provides comprehensive online training in PLC programming, HMI development, robotics, and industrial automation fundamentals. The platform serves automation professionals and beginners through interactive courses, step-by-step tutorials, free educational resources, and industry certification exam preparation.

## Key Topics

- PLC Programming
- Ladder Logic
- HMI Development
- Industrial Automation
- Allen-Bradley
- Siemens TIA Portal
- FANUC Robotics
- OT Networking
- Servo Motors
- NPN Sensors
- IIoT & Industry 4.0
- Automation Training
- Troubleshooting
- WinCC Unified
- Workforce Development

## Core Training & Courses

- [SolisPLC Homepage](https://www.solisplc.com): Expert-led online PLC programming and automation training platform
- [All Courses Catalog](https://www.solisplc.com/courses-all): Complete catalog of PLC programming and automation courses for all levels
- [Get Started - Pricing & Plans](https://www.solisplc.com/join): Subscription options and pricing plans for SolisPLC automation training courses
- [PLC Programming Tutorials](https://www.solisplc.com/tutorials): Step-by-step tutorials on PLC programming, HMI design, and industrial automation

## Specialized Courses

- [OT Networking Fundamentals](https://www.solisplc.com/courses/ot-networking-fundamentals): Free course on OT networking fundamentals with hands-on labs and troubleshooting
- [FANUC Robotics Troubleshooting](https://www.solisplc.com/courses/fanuc-robotics-troubleshooting-course): FANUC robotics troubleshooting course covering hardware, software, and error handling
- [PLCNext Associate Certification Exam](https://www.solisplc.com/certification/plcnext-associate-exam): PLCNext Associate Certification Exam covering hardware and software fundamentals

## Foundational Guides & Resources

- [PLC Programming Ultimate Beginner Guide](https://www.solisplc.com/what-is-plc-programming): Ultimate beginner guide to PLC programming and career advancement in automation
- [HMI Programming Guide](https://www.solisplc.com/hmi-programming-guide): Beginner guide to HMI programming, software selection, and system design
- [PLC Programming Fundamentals Book](https://www.solisplc.com/books/plc-programming-fundamentals-book): Free ebook on PLC programming fundamentals for career preparation and interviews
- [Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) Guide](https://www.solisplc.com/industrial-internet-of-things-iiot): Comprehensive guide to IIoT, Industry 4.0, and real-world industrial automation applications
- [Complete Servo Motor Guide](https://www.solisplc.com/servo-motor): Complete guide to servo motors, types, construction, and industrial automation applications

## Advanced Tutorials

- [WinCC Unified Faceplate Tutorial](https://www.solisplc.com/tutorials/wincc-unified-faceplate-tutorial): Step-by-step WinCC Unified and TIA Portal tutorial for scalable HMI motor faceplates
- [NPN Sensors & PLC Input Connections](https://www.solisplc.com/tutorials/npn-sensors-sinking-sourcing-plc): Tutorial on NPN sensors, 24V DC wiring, and PLC input connections for automation
